status: inputs-only; model-call protocol remains unfrozen until Task 6.2
selection_algorithm: Rank candidates by ascending SHA256(UTF8(salt + '|' + opaque item_id)), tie-break item_id. Greedily accept within cohort/ticker/direction quota if its six-session evidence-plus-outcome window does not overlap an accepted window for the same cohort/ticker. No model outputs, retries, or resampling influence selection. Fail rather than shrink an underfilled stratum.
evaluation_order: For each ticker (IAU, SPY) and direction (-1, 1), preserve selection rank within cohorts and emit pre0,post0,post1,pre1. This balances cohort and ticker/direction strata on both item-index parities consumed by the runner's alternating arm order.
price_basis: Yahoo indicators.quote[0].close, not adjclose; source may already adjust historical quotes for splits. Round exact JSON Decimal values to USD 0.01 using ROUND_HALF_UP before both evidence and next-session direction. Exclude ties after rounding. This is quoted-price direction, not total return.
window_rules: Five consecutive expected completed exchange-session closes ending at as_of, followed by the next expected session outcome. All six dates stay in the declared window. Exclude any missing/invalid bar or declared dividend/split/capital-gain action anywhere in the six dates. All post evaluation evidence, as_of and outcome dates are strictly after the maximum sourced cutoff.

calendar.scope: Explicit NYSE/Arca weekday/full-day-closure calendar for 2021-2026. Early-close sessions remain eligible; all selected sessions are historical and completed. No fill-forward or invented prices.

matching.source: Yahoo Finance public chart API, same collection batch and parameters for both tickers across all periods
matching.task: next-session quoted-close direction from five trailing completed daily closes
matching.format: price-evidence-v1; identical source-qualified evidence and neutral JSON direction/confidence instructions
matching.selection: SHA256 deterministic rank, outcome-balanced cohort/ticker strata, disjoint six-session windows

limitations: This is a retrospective quote snapshot, not a contemporaneous archive. Revisions and historical split adjustment may affect even old evidence. Source action metadata may be incomplete.
Source and prompt format are matched; years, price levels, market regimes and calendar composition differ. Matching does not eliminate temporal confounding.
Outcome labels define a balanced research sample. Each constant-direction baseline has accuracy 0.5. Do not claim population forecasting skill from this selected sample.
IS/OOS are weak timing proxies for NIM only, not verified training membership; both prompt content and market regime differ across years.
No provider calls, model-call settings, repetition counts, fidelity audit or request budgets are frozen by input preparation. Tasks 6.2-6.5 remain pending.
